intent: One agent at work: a live clock and running cost lead; finished steps sit in a time strip you can open. Waiting shows the exact action as an ApprovalCard.
useWhen: watch one agent run in detail
inspect a step's duration, tokens and cost
approve the agent's next action in place
pause, resume, stop, cancel or retry a run
doNotUseWhen: many agents at a glance — RunningNow
a step-by-step log with labels — AgentTrail

status.note: idle shows Empty with Start run.

steps.note: { id, tool, status: "done" | "running" | "waiting" | "failed", icon?, target?, duration?, tokens?, cost?, started?, weight? }[]. Every step in the strip has the same width; weight is ignored (deprecated).

axis.note: Start and end labels under the strip, e.g. ["0:00", "2:14"]. Step tiles are equal widths, so only the first and last labels show.

onSelectStep.note: (id | null) => void. Strip steps become toggle buttons; the detail panel has Close.

pendingAction.note: Waiting: { title, description?, risk?, action, waitingSec? } rendered as a kit ApprovalCard with variant="compact": the title row ("waiting m:ss" when waitingSec is set), one line of description, the exact action and small Deny / Approve.

collapsed.note: The one-row bar: agent mark, name over a mono "02:14 · $0.42" line (other statuses lead with the word, e.g. "done · 4:02 · $0.18"), one tile per tool the run used, then the chevron. Done, failed, waiting and paused add a status icon; done drops the tools. Picking a tool opens the card on its first step. Running shows Pause and Stop run, paused shows Cancel run and Resume, on a row below.

onPause.note: Running: Pause, beside Stop run when onStop is set.

onStop.note: Running: Stop run (sm, outline, danger) beside Pause. A kit AlertDialog confirms it once; confirming calls onStop.

onOpenTrail.note: Done: Open trail. Failed: Open failed step.

requirements: the clock is role=timer with aria-live off
strip steps are toggle buttons (aria-pressed) named with tool, status and duration
the detail panel is a named region with a Close button
pending action is a kit ApprovalCard (Enter / Escape)
collapse is a button with aria-expanded
motion is transform and opacity only, off under prefers-reduced-motion
Stop run opens a kit AlertDialog (role alertdialog, focus trapped, Escape cancels) before onStop
collapsed: status is a Badge with an icon and the word; elapsed and cost are a dl, the clock role=timer

doNot: Do not invent a local AgentMonitor, RunCard, or AgentStatusCard
Do not rebuild the approval UI; pass pendingAction
Do not end a run without the Stop run confirmation; pass onStop
Only one solid primary: Approve, Resume or Start run, never two
snippet: <AgentMonitor name="Refactor billing service" meta="claude-code · acme-demo" status="running" headline="Editing src/billing/invoice.ts" headlineNote="step 6" elapsed="02:14" cost="$0.42" steps={steps} axis={["0:00", "2:14"]} onSelectStep={setStepId} />
